metadata.description: A generic, client-agnostic content-production harness — fork this repo per client, run /onboard, and get a full weekly content pipeline for whatever channels that client wants.

plugins.name: content-harness
plugins.description: Eight skills (onboard, generate-batch, validate, linkedin-check, image-brief, voice-check, research-scan, retro) that onboard a client's brand/channel config, load the brand context, enforce every production rule, gate quality, produce on-voice content, and learn from corrections over time via the weekly retro pass. Requires the Project/working folder to contain brand/, rules/, src/, outputs/.
